summary: This document outlines the design and implementation plan for ClankerLog hook management helpers to automate agent configuration safely.
responsibilities: Define requirements for installing, status checking, and uninstalling agent Stop hooks.
Detail cross-slice development phases for implementing pure config transforms, filesystem safety, and CLI commands.
Establish preservation rules for existing configurations and third-party hooks.
Outline testing strategies for idempotent installs, dry-run simulations, and atomic JSON writes.
